Scout IP | Founding Full Stack Developer (AI x Patent Intelligence x Graphs) | Italy / Remote

We’re building an AI system for patent search that non-experts can actually use. We already have: a working MVP (150M+ patents indexed)& a waiting list of research centers and funds ready for pilots. Now we need someone to help turn it into a real product.

You’ll work on: multi-tenant SaaS (org accounts, roles, audit) knowledge graph integration (OriginTrail) RAG + semantic search pipelines core product decisions, not just implementation

Looking for a full stack engineer who: has actually built with LLM systems is comfortable owning systems end-to-end prefers early-stage building over polished environments

Comp: Early-stage salary + equity.

Contact: https://t.me/annaskaz or as.kazazaeva@gmail.com
